lines.text: Zephaniah urges the humble to seek the LORD and righteousness before the Day of the LORD's anger comes.
Gaza will be abandoned and Ashkelon left in ruins, and the coast will belong to the remnant of Judah.
Moab will be like Sodom and the Ammonites like Admah, because they taunted the LORD's people in their pride.
The nations of every shore will bow in worship to the LORD, who will stretch out His hand against the north and destroy Babylon.
Nineveh will become a desolation, as dry as a desert, where herds and owls settle and passersby hiss and shake their fists.
